about: CLPS deliveries, every field sourced. A field that is null is listed in unconfirmed_fields. instrument_types is a classification made by this project from each payload's sourced description (see docs/data-sources.md), not a NASA taxonomy. Schema v2 (ADR-10) adds each mission's launch vehicle, pad, launch instant, transfer, descent limits, radio, spacecraft, rovers and return, each with its own source in field_sources or listed in unconfirmed_fields.
